team_history.note: Drafted No. 20 overall by Eagles in 2026 NFL Draft; college: USC

workload.note: Led Power Four in receiving yards (1,156), 6.6 rec/gm, 11 receiving TD + 2 rush TD + 1 passing TD; 5 games of 100+ receiving yards; PFF's highest-graded college WR (90.4 overall). Named 2025 Polynesian College Football Player of the Year (2025-12-16) and won the 2025 Biletnikoff Award. Career USC totals: 137 rec, 2,008 yds, 14 TD.

contract.note: Signed a rookie deal reported at ~$20.8M, the first of all 32 first-round picks to sign in 2026, just 5 days after the draft.

scheme.note: Eagles offense 'in transition' following the A.J. Brown trade to the Patriots (agreed ~2026, per ESPN/Eagles.com); HC is Nick Sirianni.

competition.name: DeVonta Smith
competition.note: Signed 3-yr/$75M extension with Eagles (April 2024, historical); remains WR1 as of Aug 2026 camp reports.

competition.name: Dontayvion Wicks
competition.note: Acquired via trade from Green Bay (agreed 2026-04-13) for Day 3 picks; signed to a 1-yr, $12.5M extension with PHI. As of 2026-08-10, reported to have an 'early edge' at the No. 2 WR spot ahead of Lemon.

competition.name: Dallas Goedert
competition.note: Named as secondary target option in Eagles passing game per Footballguys draft-day reaction (2026-04-24).

competition.name: Darius Cooper
competition.note: Per Yardbarker (2026-08-10), Cooper has 'performed better in camp' than Lemon, further clouding Lemon's path to playing time.

competition.name: Marquise Brown
competition.note: Listed as part of WR competition in Footballguys draft reaction (pre-A.J. Brown-trade dynamics).

competition.name: Elijah Moore
competition.note: Listed as part of WR competition in Footballguys draft reaction.

notes: Many scouts/evaluators view Lemon primarily as a slot receiver; the Eagles' offense will require him to prove he can win outside routes per Footballguys.

Footballguys (2026-04-24, before A.J. Brown trade was reflected) projected 80% snap share and Week 1 starter status — since superseded by hamstring-driven camp reports in Aug 2026 (see volatile.injury).

camp.quote: Lemon missed half the spring and so far half of training camp, and on the days he did practice he didn't do a whole lot.
camp.who: Brandon Lee Gowton, Bleeding Green Nation (via Yardbarker)

camp.quote: Lemon still has time to get healthy and make a case for earning a sizable role Week 1.
The rookie continues to work his way back to full health.
